title: Think N.Y.C. Is Expensive? You Haven’t Looked at South Florida. - The New York Times
snippet:
The bureau, a part of the Department of Commerce, published the finding in a July update to the Regional Price Parities (R.P.P.) index, which compares living expenses among geographic areas, including goods, housing, utilities and other services. The update is based on 2024 data. [...] 10.5%
